---
title: DOCX figure captions and alt text (markdown)
format: docx
_quarto:
  tests:
    docx:
      ensureDocxXpath:
        -
          # plain figure
          - "//w:p[w:pPr/w:pStyle/@w:val='ImageCaption'][string-join(.//w:t, '')='C03 plain caption']"
          # cross-referenced figure
          - "//w:p[w:pPr/w:pStyle/@w:val='ImageCaption'][string-join(.//w:t, '')='Figure\u00a01: C04 xref caption']"
          # subfigure panel: both subcaptions and the panel caption
          - "//w:p[w:pPr/w:pStyle/@w:val='ImageCaption'][string-join(.//w:t, '')='(a) C05a sub caption']"
          - "//w:p[w:pPr/w:pStyle/@w:val='ImageCaption'][string-join(.//w:t, '')='(b) C05b sub caption']"
          - "//w:p[w:pPr/w:pStyle/@w:val='ImageCaption'][string-join(.//w:t, '')='Figure\u00a02: C05 panel caption']"
          # div float with fig-alt on the div
          - "//w:p[w:pPr/w:pStyle/@w:val='ImageCaption'][string-join(.//w:t, '')='Figure\u00a03: C06 div caption']"
          # non-crossref layout-ncol
          - "//w:p[w:pPr/w:pStyle/@w:val='ImageCaption'][string-join(.//w:t, '')='C07a layout caption']"
          - "//w:p[w:pPr/w:pStyle/@w:val='ImageCaption'][string-join(.//w:t, '')='C07b layout caption']"
          # empty fig-alt
          - "//w:p[w:pPr/w:pStyle/@w:val='ImageCaption'][string-join(.//w:t, '')='C08 empty alt caption']"
          # linked image
          - "//w:p[w:pPr/w:pStyle/@w:val='ImageCaption'][string-join(.//w:t, '')='C09 linked caption']"
          # fig-alt with markdown and XML special characters
          - "//w:p[w:pPr/w:pStyle/@w:val='ImageCaption'][string-join(.//w:t, '')='C11 special caption']"
          # cross-referenced figure with a rich caption keeps its emphasis
          - "//w:p[w:pPr/w:pStyle/@w:val='ImageCaption'][starts-with(string-join(.//w:t, ''), 'Figure\u00a04: C12 rich caption')][.//w:r[w:rPr/w:i]/w:t='rich']"
          # image in a callout
          - "//w:p[w:pPr/w:pStyle/@w:val='ImageCaption'][string-join(.//w:t, '')='C13 callout caption']"
          # both fig-alt and alt
          - "//w:p[w:pPr/w:pStyle/@w:val='ImageCaption'][string-join(.//w:t, '')='C14 both caption']"
          # descr of images without fig-alt: plain figure uses its caption, cross-ref figure is empty
          - "//wp:docPr[@descr='C03 plain caption']"
          - "//w:tbl[.//w:t[contains(., 'C04 xref caption')]]//wp:docPr[@descr='']"
          # descr of the callout icon is empty
          - "//w:tbl[.//w:t[.='Note']]//wp:docPr[@descr='']"
          # descr of images with fig-alt or alt is that value
          - "//wp:docPr[@descr='C01 ALT-ONLY']"
          - "//wp:docPr[@descr='C02 ALT-ONLY']"
          - "//wp:docPr[@descr='C05a ALT-ONLY']"
          - "//wp:docPr[@descr='C06 ALT-ONLY']"
          - "//wp:docPr[@descr='C07a ALT-ONLY']"
          - "//wp:docPr[@descr='C09 ALT-ONLY']"
          - "//wp:docPr[@descr='C10 ALT-ONLY']"
          - "//wp:docPr[@descr='C11 ALT-ONLY a *b* <c> & d']"
          - "//wp:docPr[@descr='C12 ALT-ONLY']"
          - "//wp:docPr[@descr='C13 ALT-ONLY']"
          # descr of an image with empty fig-alt stays empty instead of using the caption
          - "//w:p[w:pPr/w:pStyle/@w:val='ImageCaption'][string-join(.//w:t, '')='C08 empty alt caption']/preceding-sibling::w:p[1]//wp:docPr[@descr='']"
        -
          # alt text never becomes visible text
          - "//w:t[contains(., 'ALT-ONLY')]"
          - "//w:tbl[.//w:t[contains(., 'C04 xref caption')]]//wp:docPr[@descr!='']"
          - "//wp:docPr[@descr='C08 empty alt caption']"
---

Pins how figure captions and alt text render in DOCX for every way an image can reach the document.
Visible captions must stay unchanged whatever the filter pipeline does with alt text, and every alt value carries a marker that must never appear in the document text.
The image description (`descr`) is the `fig-alt` or `alt` value when one is set, and the caption for a plain figure or empty for a cross-referenced one otherwise.
An explicit empty `fig-alt` keeps the description empty: it is not replaced by the caption, although Word does not treat the image as decorative.

C01 inline image: text ![C01 inline caption](image.png){fig-alt="C01 ALT-ONLY"} text.

C02 inline image with alt attribute: text ![C02 inline caption](image.png){alt="C02 ALT-ONLY"} text.
